description: Date/time bookability in Queensland time (AEST, no daylight saving) only — not prices (use get_quote for fares). Checks the operator's live settings for private Gold Coast / Brisbane / Byron Bay transfers (after-hours window, days off and blocked dates, optionally per vehicle). Times outside standard hours are bookable as after-hours requests (surcharge may apply); same-day should phone. Not a driver calendar: the operator confirms every booking.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD in Queensland time (AEST, no daylight saving)

time.description: HH:MM 24h in Queensland time (AEST, no daylight saving)

vehicle.description: sedan | carnival | maxi | eqb | v300 (optional; checks that vehicle's days off)
